registered_entity_scope: structure-resolved small molecules against single-protein targets with a resolvable protein sequence
raw_payload_policy: download once, hash, quarantine, and never pass to prediction code
independence_definition: non-BindingDB source release and curation process
exact canonical-small-molecule/protein-sequence pair absent from every prior-exposure ledger
stable source PMID and DOI absent from previously exposed source-document ledgers
no GtoPdb outcome used for training, model selection, threshold selection, or figure design
claim_boundary: Registration establishes source identity and eligibility rules only; it contains no row-level GtoPdb affinity values or model results.
